name: Yoshimi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yoshimi town emblem in green: an outlined four-pointed star with a small disc at the centre.
history: Municipal flag of Yoshimi, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in November 1954.

features.role: Yoshimi town emblem — an outlined four-pointed star with a small disc at the centre
